packageRules.description: Hold the Python runtime below 3.14: pyoxipng ships no cp314 wheel, so uv falls back to a maturin source build and the slim image has no Rust toolchain. Lift once pyoxipng publishes cp314.

Hold TypeScript below 7: svelte-check refuses to start against TS7 unless both TS7 and TS6 are installed and it is passed --tsgo. Lift once svelte-check ships a release that supports TS7 on its own (latest is 4.7.6).
